candidates.title: The Message With a Missing Flash
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the harbor's rescue signal always lost its third flash during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they replaced the lamp bulb but the pattern stayed incomplete; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized a turning weather vane briefly blocked the beam on each rotation; they planned a safer joint response.
With the community helpers watching, they raised the signal above the vane and verified the full code offshore, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Bridge That Rose Without Rain
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the floating footbridge lifted sharply each afternoon despite steady river levels during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they added ballast but the bridge still rose unevenly; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized air trapped beneath a repair pontoon expanded in the afternoon heat; they planned a safer joint response.
With the community helpers watching, they vented the pontoon safely and installed a pressure relief fitting, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Melody That Led Travelers Astray
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered visitors following musical trail markers repeatedly reached the wrong clearing during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they repainted the arrows but the detour persisted; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized two different chimes produced identical notes when heard across the valley; they planned a safer joint response.
With the community helpers watching, they retuned one marker and added visible route symbols, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
